heroTitle: The product development system for teams and agents
heroSubtitle: Purpose-built for planning and building products. Designed for the AI era.

featureSections.title: Six cards, one command center, built-in AI
featureSections.description: Cycle through focus, blockers, replies, and events on a 3D wheel picker, or query the Supervisor AI directly with natural language and file attachments. Track live tool execution logs in real-time.

featureSections.title: Tasks, calendars, and schedules in one unified flow
featureSections.description: Plan work with strict dependency blocking, Kanban, and calendar views. Tasks automatically sync with Google Calendar, allowing the AI scheduler to find free slots and auto-allocate time slots.

featureSections.title: Notion-quality docs, built right in
featureSections.description: Block-based rich-text editor with real-time collaborative editing, subpage hierarchies, cover images, and Notion sync. Full TipTap editor with slash commands and @mentions.

featureSections.title: Stop losing what was decided in your last meeting
featureSections.description: Record audio with 5 visualizer styles, auto-transcribe with speaker diarization using Sarvam AI (23 Indian languages) or ElevenLabs. Turn decisions into tasks instantly.

featureSections.title: Custom databases, dynamic fields, and omnichannel pipelines
featureSections.description: Build custom databases for contacts, accounts, and deal pipelines with 11+ field types, interactive Kanban and spreadsheet layouts, omnichannel webhooks, native email outreach, and AI meeting transcript BANT extraction.

featureSections.title: Multi-book accounting ledgers and automated payroll
featureSections.description: Manage multi-book accounting ledgers, issue custom recurring invoices, automate bank statement reconciliation, run employee payroll with digital payslips, and monitor 11 built-in financial reports.
